points: Boston Dynamics has selected a Korean-led supply chain for Atlas and asked suppliers to prepare for purchase orders covering 10,000 humanoid robots , according to KED Global’s October 27 report .
Citing people familiar with the matter, KED says final quantities and component prices remain undecided, with initial purchase orders expected as early as late 2027 or early 2028.
KED identifies Hyundai Mobis as the supplier of all 31 actuators covered in its reporting, and says a consortium with IL and Namuga secured the headlamp and main-camera work.

title: Semtech brings 5G network slicing, FIPS 140-3 to IACP 2026
summary: Semtech is adding 5G network slicing support, FIPS 140-3 compliance via a software update and new fleet management tools to its AirLink routers for public safety fleets.
points: Semtech will demonstrate the new capabilities on stand 2964 at the International Association of Chiefs of Police (IACP) conference in Orlando, Florida.

In a recent survey, 64% of first responders named unreliable network connectivity as their single biggest concern (Source: T-Mobile, “5G and Public Safety: Transforming Emergency Response with T-Priority,” T-Mobile Newsroom, 2025).
“Resilient communication is not a capacity problem; it’s a priority and a data security problem,” said Kinana Hussein, the vice president of networking solutions at Semtech.
